subject: Workplace Skills
title: Consistency Over Charisma
description: A quick, practical guide to Consistency Over Charisma.

hook.text: The most trusted leaders aren't the most charismatic. They're the most predictable. Consistency breeds safety.

buildup.text: Teams can't perform if the leader's mood changes daily. Unpredictable reactions make people walk on eggshells.

discovery.text: Consistent leaders react the same way to good news and bad news. Their steady presence calms the entire team.

twist.text: Charismatic leaders attract followers. Consistent leaders retain them. Retention matters more than attraction.

climax.text: Be the same person in crisis and in calm. Your team watches your reaction to judge how bad things really are.

punchline.text: Same leader every day. Consistency outlasts charisma.

quiz.question: Why is consistency more important than charisma in leadership?
options: Consistent reactions create safety; unpredictable moods create anxiety
